privileged_info_for_vlm: The ADRB2 protein (P07550) is exactly 413 amino acids long. A Kyte-Doolittle plot with a window of 19 will show 7 prominent hydrophobic peaks corresponding to the 7 transmembrane helices. Approximate coordinates for ADRB2 TM domains are: TM1 (~29-52), TM2 (~67-92), TM3 (~103-128), TM4 (~141-163), TM5 (~193-219), TM6 (~267-295), TM7 (~305-328). The CSV export in UGENE is typically accessed by right-clicking the graph area or using the 'Export' button in the Graphs column.
